## AMD Posts Record $11.5B Revenue Quarter and Raises $4.75B Bond for AI Expansion; Stock Up ~6%

Record revenue alongside a large debt raise for AI investment signals AMD is accelerating its competitive posture rather than harvesting the current cycle; the bond financing implies management sees a multi-year demand runway worth leveraging the balance sheet to capture, raising the stakes on execution against NVDA.

- AMD reported record quarterly revenue of $11.5 billion.
- The company followed the print with a $4.75 billion bond raise earmarked for AI expansion.
- AMD shares rose 6.4% following the bond sale announcement.
- Stock held above $514 post-results per one outlet; high classifier confidence across chip design and AI capex themes.
